title: Add fuzz tests for SCHC fragment parser
description: The Fragment::from_bytes parser should be fuzz-tested to ensure it handles all malformed inputs gracefully without panicking. The ALL_1 underflow bug was not caught by existing tests.
close_reason: Added comprehensive fuzz tests for SCHC fragment parser: Fixed fuzz crate workspace configuration, updated Fragment/Ack/Receiver/Sender fuzzing, fixed broken imports
